title: Locally constant finite type module sheaves on a small site
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], let $B$ be a commutative ring, and let $F$ be a sheaf of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] over the constant ring sheaf $\underline B$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Say that $F$ is locally constant of finite type if for every object $V$ there is a covering sieve $S$ on $V$ such that for every arrow $U\to V$ in $S$ there is a finitely generated $B$-module $M$ [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] with $F|_U\cong\underline M|_U$ as $\underline B|_U$-modules. Restrictions are on localized ringed sites [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. The constant module sheaf is obtained by sheafifying the constant module presheaf of [def-weil-pbc-strict-perfect-coefficient-package] along the constant-ring sheafification unit. Forgetting commutativity from that unit leaves it locally injective and locally surjective, so module sheafification is defined.
